diameterInterpretation: Nonconvex ADAM shape constrained by resolved AO imaging, light curves and occultations. The selected archive gives 143 ± 3 km equivalent-volume size; its size error is not local shape accuracy. The grid marks unavailable imagery; rotational phase is illustrative.

calibration.uncertaintyKind: Selected archive equivalent-diameter error; not a local shape-accuracy bound or automatically a one-sigma confidence interval.
calibration.diameterSemantics: Selected DAMIT archived solution volume-equivalent diameter, independently checked against raw mesh volume.
calibration.limitations: Hanuš 2017 rejects the opposite pole using two disk-resolved AO images and three occultation epochs. Archive D143±3 km and pole(251,63) are retained rather than paper ensemble D141±3 km and pole(250,58). No resolved surface imagery is projected onto this mesh.
